name: Model-based Solid Texture Synthesis
aliases: Model-based Solid Texture Synthesis for Anatomic Volume Illustration
definition: A post-segmentation volume illustration method that synthesizes progressively variant solid textures constrained by a 3D vector field and patient-specific material information to visualize orientation, internal structure, and local properties of anatomical objects.
summary: Model-based Solid Texture Synthesis generates 3D textures from 2D exemplars using model-based vector fields to preserve structural continuity across complex orientations.
